# Effects

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## add_counters

Put `amount` counters of kind `counter` (+1/+1, -1/-1, loyalty) on each referenced permanent.

Rules: CR 122.1, CR 122.6, CR 613.4c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counter` | +1/+1 | -1/-1 | loyalty |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "+1/+1",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## counter

Counter each referenced spell: it leaves the stack for its owner's graveyard without resolving.

Rules: CR 701.6a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "counter": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## create_token

Create `amount` tokens under the referenced player's control (default: you). `token` is a predefined token name (Treasure, Clue, Food) or an inline card definition. `tapped: true` creates them tapped.

Rules: CR 111.1, CR 111.10, CR 701.7a, CR 704.5d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `token` | "Treasure" | "Clue" | "Food" | {card data} |
| `amount` | integer (default 1) |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `to` | selector (default "you") |

```json
{
  "create_token": {
    "token": {
      "name": "Soldier",
      "types": [
        "creature"
      ],
      "subtypes": [
        "soldier"
      ],
      "power": 1,
      "toughness": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## deal_damage

Deal `amount` damage to each referenced creature, planeswalker or player. Damage to a player causes life loss; to a planeswalker removes loyalty counters; to a creature is marked until cleanup.

Rules: CR 120.3a, CR 120.3c, CR 120.3e, CR 120.6

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "deal_damage": {
    "amount": 3,
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## search_library

Search your library for up to `count` cards matching `for`, then put them into your hand (or onto the battlefield, tapped if `tapped`) and shuffle. With a stated quality you may find fewer (or none); a search for just "a card" must find one if it can. `reveal` shows the found cards to every player.

Rules: CR 701.23a, CR 701.23b, CR 701.23d, CR 701.23e, CR 701.20a, CR 701.24a, CR 701.24b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `for` | card spec: "card" (default), {"types"|"subtypes"|"supertypes": [...], "name": "..."} or {"any_of": [spec, ...]} |
| `count` | integer (default 1) or "any" (any number) |
| `put` | "hand" (default) or "battlefield" |
| `tapped` | true: the cards enter tapped (with put: battlefield) |
| `reveal` | true: reveal the found cards |

```json
{
  "search_library": {
    "for": {
      "supertypes": [
        "basic"
      ],
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    },
    "reveal": true
  }
}
```
